output.brief: The GET latency regression is most likely caused by the 2 Nov storage-node compaction tuning change (FC-7710), not by gateway 5.8. In every cell, p99 jumped within minutes of the config push, and disk utilisation went from 41% to 97% with read queue waits rising sharply. Gateway 5.8 arrived in cells that showed no regression: aps-3 got 5.8 at 01:05 without the config push and stayed at about 94 ms. Rolling euw-1 back to 5.7 on 6 Nov also left p99 near 295 ms. Traffic growth (+6%) and the network problem were both ruled out. Confidence is moderate-to-high, but the cause of the compaction backlog (Orrin migration vs. the cold-tier deletion sweep) is not yet attributed; that report is due 10 Nov. Next steps: revert FC-7710 in one cell first and watch p99 and disk utilisation, then extend if it recovers. Do not roll back to 5.7 today: it does not address the cause and would reopen the SEC-2291 audit exposure. Do not pause compaction, since that risks disk-full. Hold Orrin rate-limiting until attribution is confirmed.
